subject: SecureSync Gateway: accreditation & evidence safekeeping onboarding
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumensec.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lucas Reed <lucas@cobaltconsult.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Secure Sync Gateway — integration & accreditation kickoff

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the intro via the partner portal — excited to kick off work on the SecureSync Gateway connector. LumenSec is preparing our accreditation package (SOC 2 + evidence escrow options) for customers who want a hosted GRC <> Redwood sync. Two quick asks before we get everyone on a call:

1) Can you confirm Redwood's preferred evidence retention windows and whether we can support an S3-backed evidence escrow (we'll provide KMS keys on request)?
2) We'd like to align on pen-test expectations for the connector itself (scope, cadence, and whether Redwood will accept third-party pen reports).

I've attached a short requirements overview to speed the conversation: LumenSec-connector-requirements.pdf (stub). We'll propose a 30-min kickoff — next Tue/Wed AM PT works for our team.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Partnerships, LumenSec
Attachments: LumenSec-connector-requirements.pdf (1 page PDF)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumensec.io>
Cc: Lucas Reed <lucas@cobaltconsult.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure Sync Gateway — integration & accreditation kickoff

Hi Olivia — great to meet you. Thanks for the doc; I skimmed it and it looks straightforward.

We can support S3-backed escrow and Redwood can accept customer-provided KMS keys; we also have an HSM-backed option for enterprise private deployments. Marcus (partner integrations) and Karthik (security & compliance) are looped in to confirm retention defaults and pen-test policy.

Proposed: 30-min sync Wed 2027-05-26 at 9:30 AM PT. If that works for you I’ll send a calendar invite.

Ahead of the call, could you share the pen-test scope you mentioned and any redlines you anticipate on the SOW? We typically require a mutual action plan for evidence access and a short SOW addendum for escrow handling.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumensec.io>
Date: 2027-05-23T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Secure Sync Gateway — integration & accreditation kickoff (internal alignment)

Rachel/Karthik — quick internal note before Wed's call.

- Ownership: I’ll own the SOW + commercial addendum; Rachel will run the partner ops cadence.
- Retention: our default hosted evidence retention is 7 years; we can offer 90/365/7y presets and custom windows for enterprise. Karthik, confirm whether 7 years is okay for LumenSec's use-case or if they require shorter windows for escrow.
- Pen-tests: Redwood accepts third-party pen reports but requires scoped test evidence (attack surface, CVE mapping, remediation timelines). We should provide a template acceptance checklist.

I've attached a draft SOW template and our evidence handling spec for the call: redwood-sow-template.docx (stub); evidence-handshake-spec.xlsx (stub).

Marcus Lin
Head, Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-sow-template.docx, evidence-handshake-spec.xlsx
From: Lucas Reed <lucas@cobaltconsult.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumensec.io>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure Sync Gateway — integration & accreditation kickoff

Hi all — Lucas from Cobalt Consulting here. Olivia looped me in; Cobalt will be performing the connector pen-test work if the scope is agreed. Attached is our proposed scope (Cobalt-penplan.pdf). A few clarifications that will affect timing/cost:

- We need a list of endpoints the connector will hit (API hostnames + agent endpoints).
- Expected testing window (we prefer a 2-week testing window with a one-week remediation window).
- Will Redwood provide a temporary test tenancy or should we test against LumenSec staging?

Also: Olivia, please send any redlines to the SOW early — we'll try to align our report format to Redwood's acceptance checklist.

Thanks,
Lucas Reed
Engagement Manager, Cobalt Consulting
Attachments: Cobalt-penplan.pdf (2 page PDF)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumensec.io>, Lucas Reed <lucas@cobaltconsult.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-25T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure Sync Gateway — integration & accreditation kickoff (next steps)

Team — solid progress. Confirming next steps and links: 

1) Meeting: Wed 2027-05-26 9:30 AM PT — calendar invite sent.
2) DocuSign: I will route an SOW addendum for escrow handling and the mutual action plan via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded/ABC1234 (stub).
3) Evidence exchange: shared Drive folder for artifacts and interim reports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D-evidence-exchange (access will be provisioned to LumenSec/Cobalt).
4) Pen-test logistics (Lucas): Redwood can provide a temporary test tenancy for the connector and will supply endpoint inventory by EOD Mon 2027-05-24. Karthik will confirm required acceptance checklist items.

Please review the attached evidence-handshake-spec.xlsx and send any SOW redlines before I send the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments referenced: evidence-handshake-spec.xlsx, redwood-sow-template.docx

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Rachel Kim
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172
snippet: Onboarding thread for LumenSec SecureSync Gateway: escrow options, pen-test scope, SOW routing, and next steps (DocuSign + Drive links).
